calls.statement:
SELECT COUNT(*) as total_sales_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id) as receipts
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 4;

WITH period_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    f.receipt_id,
    s.format,
    SUM(f.net_amount) as basket_net_amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 4
  GROUP BY f.receipt_id, s.format
)
SELECT 
  format,
  COUNT(*) as basket_count,
  AVG(basket_net_amount) as avg_basket_value,
  ROUND(AVG(basket_net_amount), 2) as avg_basket_value_rounded
FROM period_sales
GROUP BY format
ORDER BY format;

SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_lines,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END) as staff_purchases,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN net_amount < 0 THEN 1 END) as negative_amounts,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN net_amount = 0 THEN 1 END) as zero_amounts,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN net_amount IS NULL THEN 1 END) as null_amounts
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 4;
